verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no URL-mapping or link-discovery endpoint that returns a site's URLs without crawling it. The closest item is the CLI's 'quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl' (docs-40), but that is a crawl, which is an adjacent capability rather than instant URL discovery. The axis applies to a scraping API, so the missing evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
